Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Air India's Maharaja Club card carousel - a horizontal swipe carousel of loyalty benefit cards where the card image pans at a different rate than the card itself (parallax) and the active card scales up while neighbors shrink.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Mobile app screen for the Maharaja Club loyalty program: deep red header with the Maharaja Club wordmark, a three-icon quick-action row, then a "MEMBER OFFERS" section hosting the carousel. Cards carry full-bleed lifestyle photos with a white caption strip below ("DISCOVER FAMILY POOL", "POINTS THAT NEVER EXPIRE", "EARN EVERY TIME YOU FLY", "BUY POINTS"). A secondary promo card and the bottom tab bar sit below the carousel.

## Motion spec
Pattern: horizontal paging carousel with parallax imagery and scale emphasis.
- Carousel pages with a snap: drag moves cards 1:1 with the finger; on release, the nearest card centers (spring ~260/26, ~400ms settle).
- Parallax: each card's photo translates horizontally at ~30% of the card's own travel, so images drift against the card frame during swipes.
- Scale: the centered card sits at 1.0; side cards scale to ~0.92 and fade to ~80% opacity, interpolated continuously from scroll position (no stepped change).
- Peek: ~24px of the previous and next cards visible at the screen edges throughout.

## Calibration
- Parallax factor stays small (~0.3) - enough to feel depth, not enough to reveal image edges.
- Scale/opacity are scroll-driven, not triggered after the snap; they must track the finger live.

## Reduced motion
Standard paging carousel, no parallax, no scale change; snap keeps the same spring.

## Don't miss
- Caption strips are part of the card and move with it; only the photo parallaxes inside.
- The red header and tab bar are fixed; only the carousel region responds.
